get.summary: Read own or ACTIVE-assigned patient profile
get.description: patientId is patient_profiles.id. Uppercase hex normalizes lowercase; alternate encodings rejected. No query or body. PATIENT self only; CLINICIAN needs ACTIVE assignment; ADMIN denied. Missing profiles, forbidden/nonexistent/malformed targets share 404. Implicit HEAD uses the same authorization and no-store without a response body. Single READ COMMITTED statement; concurrent committed changes after its snapshot cannot retract an in-flight read. No CSRF required for this safe read.

post.summary: Submit one immutable paired BP measurement
post.description: PATIENT owns target profile; CLINICIAN needs current ACTIVE/null-ended assignment; ADMIN denied. Current session/user/profile/assignment revalidated under bounded transaction locks. Every response no-store. No session renewal. Recorder user UUID is persisted internally but omitted from HTTP. Entry source does not assert device operation, witnessing, medical verification or clinical validity. Exactly four properties, integer JSON tokens only: no strings, fractions, decimal/exponent spellings, negative zero, duplicate keys (including escaped equivalents), coercion, rounding, clamping or inferred defaults. No medical plausibility range. Query strings and Idempotency-Key are rejected. Non-idempotent: identical successful POSTs create distinct rows and audits; no automatic retry. No CarePlan/catalog dependency. No correction workflow or clinical qualification. application/json with optional UTF-8 charset only; identity content encoding only; 16 KiB limit. Parsing/Origin/media errors can precede authentication and reveal no target state.
